claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + species_trait mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord only has SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. There is no species_trait kind and no mechanics family to hold species-trait payloads. This is a top-level structural gap.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Gnomish Lineage is a species_trait. types.ts exports no SpeciesTraitRecord and no mechanics family for species traits.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: lineage_choice subgraph (choose between Forest Gnome and Rock Gnome at character creation)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait presents a mutually exclusive choice made once at character creation. The v4 atom `choose` exists but there is no surface family or mechanics header that models a character-creation choice between two distinct spell/feature bundles.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Choose one of the following options" — Forest Gnome (Minor Illusion + Speak with Animals innate) vs Rock Gnome (Mending + Prestidigitation + clockwork device creation).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: innate_spellcasting family (grant_spell_access + PB-keyed use_count + long_rest reset + optional spell-slot override)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Forest Gnome grants Speak with Animals as an always-prepared innate spell with PB uses, Long Rest refill, and an 'or use your own spell slots' fallback. No existing surface family models innate spellcasting from a species trait. The LevelAxis already includes 'proficiency_bonus' so PB-keyed use count could be expressed once the family exists.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object subgraph for Rock Gnome clockwork device (create_object atom + duration + activation + cap)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Rock Gnome can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device with AC 5, 1 HP, 8-hour duration, Bonus Action activation, max 3 in existence, Utilize to dismantle. The v4 atom create_object exists, but no surface family or mechanics header can carry this shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device... You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action."
